# FLX-5036: profile document refused

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

A profile is read whole or not at all, and this one does not have the shape docs/spec/PROFILE-SPEC.md gives a profile: a key the format does not define, a count that is not a non-negative JSON integer, a number written as a JSON float or in a spelling other than a plain decimal string, a statistic whose definition is not registered, or cells and flags that do not line up. The message names where in the document the problem is. Regenerate the profile with a profiler that writes this format version, or correct the named entry.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5036
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
